question: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) releases the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) at which of the following time intervals?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Monthly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)** is an important statistical tool used to measure the growth and performance of various sectors of the economy such as **manufacturing, mining, and electricity.**
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** is responsible for the release of the IIP in India.
 
• The IIP is published on a **monthly basis**, ensuring timely and regular updates about the performance of the industrial sector.
 
• The base year for calculating the IIP is currently **2011-12**, providing a standardized reference for comparison of industrial activity over time.
 
• The IIP is a crucial indicator of the economic health of the country and is often used to assess the impact of government policies, economic reforms, and external factors on industrial performance.
 
• The IIP data is categorized into three main sectors: **Manufacturing (77.63%), Mining (14.37%), and Electricity (7.99%)**, based on their contribution to the index.
 
• The monthly publication of IIP helps policymakers, economists, and researchers analyze trends and make informed decisions regarding industrial growth and development.
 
• The frequency of publication ensures that any changes in the industrial output due to factors like **seasonality, economic policies, or global market trends** are reflected promptly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Half yearly**__

 __
 
• Half-yearly reports are typically used for **financial and operational analysis** by companies and organizations. However, for indices like the IIP, a monthly release is preferred to ensure timely availability of data.
 
 
 
• **Weekly**__
 __
 
• Weekly frequency is more suitable for indicators like the **Wholesale Price Index (WPI)** for specific commodities or agricultural produce, rather than broad industrial performance measures like IIP.
 
 
 
• **Quarterly**__
 
 
• Quarterly data is commonly used for financial statements, GDP estimates, and other macroeconomic indicators. However, industrial production requires more frequent tracking to capture dynamic changes.
